title: Project Architecture & Foundations
description: Start with the project documentation and dependency specifications to understand the Afro-XLMR foundation, O(N) normalization strategy, and dual-axis sentiment classification paradigm.

title: Ge'ez Orthography Normalization Engine
description: Explore the Amharic text normalizer which provides O(N) homophone unification, labiovelar reduction, punctuation normalization, and elongation hygiene using C-level translation tables.

title: Decoupled Dual-Axis Thresholding & Calibration
description: Learn how positive and negative activation probabilities are mathematically evaluated across activation floors, dominance margins, and mixed margins to classify Positive, Negative, Neutral, and Mixed sentiments.

title: End-to-End Sentiment Inference Engine
description: Inspect the core engine class orchestrating Afro-centric transformer representations, clause extraction, batch tokenization, and latency tracking.

title: CLI Test Harness & Interactive REPL
description: Examine the Typer and Rich command-line application providing single-shot text analysis, live interactive REPL querying, and formatted benchmark execution.

title: Golden Benchmark Cases & Quality Verification
description: Understand the test harness and evaluation dataset featuring the 10 Golden Benchmark cases covering positives, negatives, factual neutrals, mixed sentiments, and modern Amharic slang.
